# Accessibility Facet

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AccessibilityFacet`](gmeow-AccessibilityFacet.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AccessibilityFacet>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/accessibility`](../../slices/accessibility.md)

The dimension of accessibility being asserted — wheelchair, step-free, visual, auditory, cognitive, clearance, life-support. An open value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses) per [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9).

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

Use [`gmeow:AccessibilityFacet`](gmeow-AccessibilityFacet.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
